CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2567 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head f16956542b2c4470de5a3e12fc843f97cef1840e. Bus nonce: add37b67f64bb470070faa4b0f8e06af. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin f16956542b2c4470de5a3e12fc843f97cef1840e`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge f16956542b2c4470de5a3e12fc843f97cef1840e` or `Fix review: blocked f16956542b2c4470de5a3e12fc843f97cef1840e <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: add37b67f64bb470070faa4b0f8e06af`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `f16956542b2c4470de5a3e12fc843f97cef1840e` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2567 f16956542b2c4470de5a3e12fc843f97cef1840e") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2567-add37b67`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Fix reviewer for PR #2567 (topic r10-row-only-update). Round 3 (flow plan, owner rulings R1-R9, #201 comment 6318002897). Read that comment and verify this head resolves each item, with your own mutants W1..W7 and the null controls (a diff touching one more file must still run prepr). Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head. Post your verdict only after the required checks at this head have concluded. Do not ask for a main absorb on a clean head. A red nightly-status grades main. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt).
